description: This file implements the AzureBlobLeaseProvider class, which manages leasing operations (acquire, release, renew) on Azure Blob Storage for distributed locking or coordination within Orleans framework.

classes.name: AzureBlobLeaseProvider
classes.description: Provides lease management (acquire, release, renew) for Azure Blob Storage within Orleans, implementing ILeaseProvider interface.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Asynchronously acquires leases for a set of resources within a category.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a set of acquired leases asynchronously.

methods.name: Renew
methods.description: Renews a set of acquired leases asynchronously.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of AzureBlobLeaseProvider using service provider and name.
